summary: Iteration 3 regression (Berber) — Backend 21/21 pytest passed against external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Covered: services list now has 5 entries with separate 'hair'(5000) and 'beard'(5000), admin auth via 07812059874, duplicate-phone 400, wrong-password 401, GET/PATCH /api/admin/settings (RBAC 403 for customer), platform_fee=500 applied on booking acceptance, barber wallet flow (wallet_balance model): zero-balance barber gets 402 with Arabic 'رصيد' when accepting; admin top-up via POST /api/admin/users/{id}/wallet adds to balance; after top-up to 2000 the accept deducts exactly 500 → balance 1500 and barber_earnings = FULL price (10000); negative admin adjust (-500) → balance 1000; wallet_txns recorded in /api/admin/users/{id} response with correct kind+booking_id; rating gated behind status=completed (400 before, 400 'تم التقييم مسبقا' on double-rate); POST /api/bookings/{id}/rating updates barber rating_avg/count; GET /api/barbers/{id} returns {barber, ratings} and excludes wallet_balance; PATCH /api/auth/me persists avatar + portfolio list. Frontend verified on preview URL: admin Users list row → /app/users/:id detail page with wallet card + top-up form works end-to-end (toast 'تم شحن 1,500 د.ع', wallet txns list updates immediately showing TEST_UI_topup/TEST_deduct/commission); AdminSettings page exposes fee-input, whatsapp-input, svc-name-0/svc-price-0, add-service-btn, save-settings-btn and POST succeeds; barber Settings page has settings-avatar/new-portfolio-input/add-portfolio-btn/save-profile-btn and persists portfolio URL; barber dashboard shows wallet balance card + dashboard-topup-btn; Wallet page for barber has topup-whatsapp-btn with prefilled wa.me URL (msg Arabic: 'مرحباً، أنا الحل…'); Chat page for both roles shows support-whatsapp-main with role-differentiated message (customer: 'مرحباً، أنا الزبون …', barber: 'مرحباً، أنا الحل…'); rate-btn-{id} renders for completed-unrated bookings on customer-home.

issues: When avatar URL is invalid/unreachable (e.g. example.com placeholder) the broken icon renders in the profile tile — consider a fallback (initial letter) when the image fails to load

critical_code_review_comments: Public /api/auth/register still accepts role='admin' from arbitrary phones (only ADMIN_PHONE auto-promotes, but an attacker can explicitly pass role='admin' on register with any other phone and be granted admin). Force role ∈ {customer, barber} on public register.

PATCH /api/auth/me accepts phone changes with zero validation — a user can overwrite their phone to an already-taken number (unique constraint not enforced). Reject duplicates or strip phone from the public update surface.
POST /api/admin/users/{id}/wallet has no guard on target role; admin can 'top up' a customer or another admin which creates orphan wallet_txns. Restrict to role=='barber'.
JWT_SECRET falls back to a hardcoded default in server.py:23 — require from env in production.
CORS uses allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True (invalid per spec) — restrict to known origins when credentials are allowed.
Avatar and portfolio URLs are stored verbatim with no validation — an http(s)://-only whitelist check is cheap and prevents javascript: injections in .
normalize_phone() does not canonicalize +964 vs 009647… vs 07… variants, so the admin-phone auto-promote only fires for the exact '07812059874' format.
Barber public profile GET /api/barbers/{id} projects out wallet_balance (good) but still leaks rating list that includes customer_name — acceptable UX, noted.
